definitions: To dress oneself in an item of clothing or accessory.
To start a device or appliance.
To apply something, such as make-up or lotion.
To stage or present a show, play, or performance.
To pretend to have a particular feeling, quality, or way of behaving.
To cause a light or other electrical device to operate.
To add an amount or item to something.
examples: She put on her coat before going out.
Could you put on the kettle for tea?
He put on sun cream before going to the beach.
I've put on a few pounds over Christmas.
They're putting on a new play at the theatre.
He's just putting on an act.
Please put on the light, it's dark in here.
The council decided to put on an extra bus service.
Don't be silly, she's just putting you on.
